editorial:
Ever wondered what happens when the least scary guy in the room suddenly becomes the boss of the mob? That is exactly where you land with this flick. You get to follow Guiseppe, who is basically a human marshmallow, as he inherits the Calzone crime family after his brother kicks the bucket. His dad knows Guiseppe is way too soft for the business, so he ships him off to Mafia University to learn how to be a tough guy. It is a goofy, lighthearted ride that feels like a sitcom mixed with a gangster movie, and the constant jokes about pasta and family drama make it a really easy watch.

The movie keeps things moving quickly with plenty of slapstick humor and some surprising twists. While the acting is a bit over-the-top, it actually fits the silly vibe of the story perfectly. If you are in the mood for something that does not take itself too seriously, you will love this. It is the perfect choice for a lazy Friday night with friends.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the rival family tries to take over during the graduation from Mafia University. Guiseppe finally finds his backbone and uses the weird lessons he learned in school to outsmart the villains. Instead of being a cold killer, he wins by being unpredictable. He saves his family, secures his spot as the boss, and proves that you do not have to be a monster to run the mob.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy comedies and mob movies.
